scripts.test:playwright: bun run build && bunx playwright install chromium && bunx playwright test --update-snapshots
scripts.test:all: bun run type-check && bun run test
scripts.verify: bun run type-check && bun run test && bun run build && bun run build:web && bunx playwright install chromium && bunx playwright test && bun run doctor
scripts.regenerate-screenshot: bun run build && bunx playwright install chromium && REGEN_SCREENSHOTS=1 bunx playwright test tests/screenshot.test.playwright.ts
scripts.render-check: bun run build && bunx playwright install chromium && RENDER_CHECK=1 bunx playwright test tests/render-check.test.playwright.ts
scripts.publish-to-poe-tiles: bun run build && poe-tiles tiles upload
